result:
This confirms the root cause lives entirely outside the item's file: `HookEvent` is declared as `export type HookEvent = unknown` in `src/packages/headless-sdk/src/agentSdkTypes.ts` (same as the vendorized source — it isn't a porting bug, it's a stub that the upstream compiles under `strict: false`). Every downstream use of `hookEventMetadata[modeState.event]` inherits that `unknown`, including line 291 of this item. Fixing it requires giving `HookEvent` a real literal-union type in `agentSdkTypes.ts`, which is outside `HooksConfigMenu.tsx` — per the rules I can't touch that file from this item, so there's nothing safe to edit here.
